List project visitors#

get/v1/projects/{id}/visitors

Requires visitor.list. Returns paginated visitors; unspecified contact and address fields are empty strings.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

pageinteger

Padrão: 1

limitinteger

Padrão: 50

filtersstring
Exemplo
curl -X GET "https://api.trackup.me/v1/projects/{id}/visitors" \
  -H "X-Api-Key: $TRACKUP_API_KEY"
Respostas
200object

Successful response.

Get a project visitor#

get/v1/projects/{id}/visitors/{visitorId}

List visitor events#

get/v1/projects/{id}/visitors/{visitorId}/events

Requires visitor.read. Events are discriminated by type: request or conversion. Timestamps retain their ClickHouse UTC representation.

Parâmetros de caminho

idstring (uuid)obrigatório
visitorIdstring (uuid)obrigatório

Parâmetros de consulta

pageinteger

limitinteger
